name: Greedtouched
description:
You have a connection to Greed, who encourages you to indulge your impulses.

When you gain this ability, gain 4d10 Treasure.

Whenever you roll 🌞, in addition to the normal effects, time stops for you for a moment and you are visited by an emissary of Greed in your mind. The emissary (piloted by the GM) offers you an additional effect that is excessive and reckless: it grants you a clear advantage, but will have consequences. If you accept the offer, resolve its effects and you gain 1 Shadow. If you refuse the offer, check two Conditions.

Describe the visitation.
